g.title: crate Interactive styled component catalog for kivact-ui-creative.
crate::creative Creative application and its modules.
crate::creative::animation_model Domain projection for graph and dope edits of the same animation.

crate::creative::audio Audio handling and timing utilities for creative.
crate::creative::audio_samples Audio sample management for the creative application.
crate::creative::audio_values Audio time formatting and level calculations for catalog views.
crate::creative::chrome Compose Creative catalog menus, accent choices and transport readouts.
crate::creative::common Shared values and view builders for Creative catalog specimens.
crate::creative::controls Control buttons and widgets for creative application.
crate::creative::editor_images Application CPU image examples, independent of the UI kit renderer.
crate::creative::editors Editors and input controls for creative editing.
crate::creative::feedback Feedback UI including menus and toasts.
crate::creative::indicators Visual indicators and status displays.
crate::creative::jobs Job and task management for creative application.
crate::creative::layout Layout and property panel for creative application.
crate::creative::layout_reducers Application reducers for catalog hierarchy and row order.
crate::creative::media_pool Media pool and asset browser for creative application.
crate::creative::node_model Application node graph constraints and edit reduction.
crate::creative::numeric_samples Numeric controls and sample display for creative.
crate::creative::shell The catalog shell: top bar, toolbar, chapter sidebar, hero and chapters.
crate::creative::txn One editing transaction: a Begin snapshot dropped at Commit or Cancel.
crate::fonts The catalog's offline OFL font bytes, for the app and its tests.
